==Biography==
Yellowpete is a player hailing from Hanover, Germany. At the age of ten, yellowpete started playing real-time strategy game "Age of Empires". Eventually yellowpete grew into games like Counter-Strike 1.6 and Counter-Strike Source, Warcraft, and Defense of the Ancients. One of yellowpete's friends who he played DotA with soon showed him League of Legends. 

As LoL grew, so did yellowpete’s skill and reputation as a top-tier player. Strong mechanical skill is something yellowpete says all of the top professional players have mastered and that what sets him apart is his continually positive attitude toward the game. He communicates well in game and continually strives to create new strategies to improve his team.

In February 2015, Yellowpete officially announced his retirement from competitive League of Legends, after a two-month-long break from playing. He expressed intentions of becoming a casual Hearthstone streamer.<ref>[https://www.facebook.com/Yellowpete.LoL/posts/836618786383772 Yellowpete's Facebook post] ''facebook.com''</ref>

== Trivia ==
* His favorite champion is {{ci|Kog'maw}}.<ref>[http://www.progamingtours.net/index.php?/League-of-Legends/counter-logic-gaming-clg.html Counter Logic Gaming - The Team] ''progamingtours.net''</ref>
** Played his signature champion {{ci|Kog'maw}} in his last LCS match.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g08j0OvRpHE Lol Esports Youtube]youtube.com</ref>
* Skydiving was one of his biggest dreams, and he was able to achieve it as part of an interview.<ref>[http://www.in2lol.com/en/news/3554-knochen-interviews-yellowpete Knochen interviews Yellowpete] ''in2lol.com''</ref>
* During Season 1 he had the highest Elo in solo queue (2507) and in Premade 5vs5 (2111) on EU West.<ref>[http://competitive.euw.leagueoflegends.com/ladders/euw/archived/1 Season One Ladders Archive] ''leagueoflegends.com''</ref>
* He and [[Krepo]] previously teamed up in the bottom lane for [[La GG]].
* Hopes to remain a part of the eSports scene once he has retired from the position of player.
* Got his nickname "yellowpete" from the eponymous character in the Mafia game.<ref>[http://www.in2lol.com/en/news/3554-knochen-interviews-yellowpete Knochen interviews Yellowpete] ''in2lol.com''</ref>
* Married on September 16, 2016.<ref>[https://twitter.com/yellowpetelol/status/776548173661822976?lang=en Yellowpete's Twitter]twitter.com</ref>
